# v1.1.0-dev.117: The quit choice, per application

Pre-release off the `dev` branch. Builds on `v1.1.0-dev.116`.

## What WLM does to a docked window on quit, decided per app

The "When WLM closes" choice is per application now. Each window docked in
a virtual window is settled by its own app's rule at quit: close its
terminals while undocking its browser, if that is what you chose. The
per-app choice is a "Close on exit" checkbox beside a window's start-mode
choice in the window editor and on the Virtual Windows page, and Settings
lists every override with a Clear button. The global choice in Settings
answers for every app without one (undock by default).

## Install

Auto-updates from dev.53 and later. Otherwise unzip and run.
